name: tpl-precedence-1-goal
task: Move the ball away from the door before you take the key. Then open the door with the key and pick up the box.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Precedence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) puts moving the ball before taking the key, Precedence(has_door_key, door_open) puts the key before opening the door, and Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) with Existence(target_picked_up) puts opening before the box pickup. The hard chain forces all four events, so no earlier-step Existence is needed.

texts: Pick up the target box (the last step of the ordered sequence, so it is required)
Open the door only after the key has been acquired, so the door is opened with the key before the box is picked up
Open the door with the key: the key must be held before the door is opened
Move the ball away from the door before taking the key
